subject.title: [Bug]: Feishu text commands (/stop, /new, /status) no longer bypass queue during active agent run (3.8 regression)

question: Should Feishu whole-message text commands during active runs be limited to a safe local fast-path subset, or should stateful commands such as `/stop` and `/new` also become authorized text-slash turns that bypass active-run queueing?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the remaining fix changes command authorization and session/queue ordering semantics, so automation should not choose the permanent policy boundary.

options.title: Choose Broad Feishu Command Policy
options.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers choose the stateful-command boundary and then sponsor one focused Feishu/core fix with live proof.

options.title: Adopt Safe Local Subset Only
options.body: Only make safe local commands such as `/status` fast and leave `/stop` and `/new` behind a separate design decision.

options.title: Restore All Reported Commands
options.body: Implement authorized text-slash command turns plus Feishu queue bypass for `/status`, `/stop`, and `/new`, with regression tests and live DM evidence.

recommendation.title: Choose Broad Feishu Command Policy
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers choose the stateful-command boundary and then sponsor one focused Feishu/core fix with live proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal is shared command authorization and command-turn policy work authored by steipete.
